findings.evidence: Lines 68–81 mention only natural powers and Nat.descFactorial; the proof uses no hypergraph definitions. The existing factorial file already exports related falling-factorial inequalities.
findings.fix: Move it to TauCeti/Data/Nat/Factorial/Basic.lean as a public theorem in namespace Nat and import it here.
findings.issue: The private pow_three_le_two_mul_descFactorial is reusable arithmetic infrastructure, inaccessible to consumers outside this file.

findings.evidence: Repository search finds no mem_unorderedSupport or unorderedSupport_def. The proofs at lines 692 and 779 unfold unorderedSupport directly, and lines 710–711 extract image witnesses without a characteristic API.
findings.fix: Add public unorderedSupport_def and mem_unorderedSupport_iff lemmas in both namespaces; annotate the membership characterizations with @[simp].
findings.issue: Polyad3.unorderedSupport and Subpolyad3.unorderedSupport (line 766) have no membership or defining lemmas, forcing consumers to unfold their bodies to introduce or extract supporting triples.

summary: General factorial infrastructure is hidden in the recoloring proof, and both unordered-support definitions lack a public membership characterization.
